title: [BUG] Strands Agent AnthropicModel emits Pydantic serialization warnings with Anthropic SDK v0.84.0
body:
### Checks

- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched [./issues](./issues?q=) and there are no duplicates of my issue

### Strands Version

v1.29.0

### Python Version

3.12

### Operating System

macOS 26.3

### Installation Method

pip

### Steps to Reproduce

When using strands-agents v1.29.0 with anthropic SDK v0.84.0, every agent invocation using AnthropicModel produces multiple Pydantic serialization warnings on stderr. The Anthropic SDK returns ParsedTextBlock objects in message content, but the Strands message serialization schema expects a discriminated union of specific block types (ThinkingBlock, ToolUseBlock, RedactedThinkingBlock, ServerToolUseBlock, WebSearchToolResultBlock, ParsedTextBlock[TypeVar]). The ParsedTextBlock doesn't match any discriminator, triggering 6+ warning lines per invocation.



### Expected Behavior

No Pydantic serialization warnings during normal agent operation. The Strands AnthropicModel provider should correctly handle ParsedTextBlock objects from the current Anthropic SDK, either by:

### Actual Behavior

The agent functions correctly — results, tool calls, and metrics are all accurate — but stderr is polluted with noisy warnings.

### Additional Context

Updating the Pydantic model's content union type to accept ParsedTextBlock properly
Normalizing ParsedTextBlock to TextBlock before serialization
Suppressing known-safe serialization warnings internally
Impact
Affects every Strands user on anthropic SDK >= 0.84.0 with AnthropicModel
Produces 6+ warning lines per agent call, cluttering output
Particularly problematic for demos, workshops, and getting-started experiences where clean output matters
Creates confusion — developers may think their code is broken
No workaround short of suppressing Python warnings globally (which hides real issues)
Supporting Evidence
Minimal reproduction — 10 lines of code:

from strands import Agent, tool
from strands.models.anthropic import AnthropicModel

model = AnthropicModel(model_id="claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens=1000)

@tool
def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    """Get weather for a city."""
    return f"{city}: 60°F, sunny"

agent = Agent(model=model, tools=[get_weather])
result = agent("What's the weather in New York?")
Warning output:

PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `ParsedTextBlock[TypeVar]` - serialized value may not be as expected [field_name='content', input_value=ParsedTextBlock(citations...xt', parsed_output=None), input_type=ParsedTextBlock])
PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `ThinkingBlock` - serialized value may not be as expected ...)
PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `RedactedThinkingBlock` - serialized value may not be as expected ...)
PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `ToolUseBlock` - serialized value may not be as expected ...)
PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `ServerToolUseBlock` - serialized value may not be as expected ...)
PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `WebSearchToolResultBlock` - serialized value may not be as expected ...)
Versions: strands-agents==1.29.0, anthropic==0.84.0, Python 3.13


### Possible Solution

Update the AnthropicModel provider's message content type definition to properly handle ParsedTextBlock from the latest Anthropic SDK. The serialization schema likely needs to either include ParsedTextBlock in the union or convert it to a plain TextBlock before passing it through Pydantic.

### Related Issues

_No response_

linked_prs.title: fix(anthropic): bypass model_dump on content_block_stop
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/strands-py/src/strands/models/anthropic.py b/strands-py/src/strands/models/anthropic.py
index 6fc29a8389..b4f7953b9e 100644
--- a/strands-py/src/strands/models/anthropic.py
+++ b/strands-py/src/strands/models/anthropic.py
@@ -472,6 +472,8 @@ async def stream(
                                     "message": {"stop_reason": event.message.stop_reason},
                                 }
                             )
+                        elif event.type == "content_block_stop":
+                            yield self.format_chunk({"type": "content_block_stop", "index": event.index})
                         else:
                             yield self.format_chunk(event.model_dump())
 
diff --git a/strands-py/tests/strands/models/test_anthropic.py b/strands-py/tests/strands/models/test_anthropic.py
index 556db18d95..79de4a76f9 100644
--- a/strands-py/tests/strands/models/test_anthropic.py
+++ b/strands-py/tests/strands/models/test_anthropic.py
@@ -1105,6 +1105,39 @@ def model_dump_with_warning():
     assert {"messageStop": {"stopReason": mock_message_stop.message.stop_reason}} in events
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_stream_content_block_stop_no_pydantic_warnings(anthropic_client, model, alist):
+    """Regression test for https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/issues/1865."""
+    mock_event = unittest.mock.Mock()
+    mock_event.type = "content_block_stop"
+    mock_event.index = 0
+
+    def model_dump_with_warning():
+        warnings.warn(
+            "PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue(Expected `ParsedTextBlock[TypeVar]`)",
+            UserWarning,
+            stacklevel=2,
+        )
+        return {"type": mock_event.type, "index": mock_event.index}
+
+    mock_event.model_dump = model_dump_with_warning
+
+    final_message = unittest.mock.Mock()
+    final_message.usage = unittest.mock.Mock(model_dump=lambda: {"input_tokens": 1, "output_tokens": 2})
+
+    mock_context = generate_mock_stream_context([mock_event], final_message=final_message)
+    anthropic_client.messages.stream.return_value = mock_context
+
+    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught_warnings:
+        warnings.simplefilter("always")
+        response = model.stream([{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "hello"}]}], None, None)
+        events = await alist(response)
+
+    pydantic_warnings = [w for w in caught_warnings if "PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue" in str(w.message)]
+    assert len(pydantic_warnings) == 0, f"Unexpected Pydantic warnings: {pydantic_warnings}"
+    assert {"contentBlockStop": {"contentBlockIndex": 0}} in events
+
+
 class TestCountTokens:
     """Tests for AnthropicModel.count_tokens native token counting."""
